notes.title: Version 2.0.2 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello Shutterbugs! 

Thanks to your reports on the community Discord, I was able to fix some important issues:

- Playing with controller will no longer restart the island you are on everytime you interact with menus
- Photos will appear in the gallery again on OSX (you have lost no photos, check the "Open Photos Folder" in the gallery!)
- You'll find a handy link pointing you to the Steam community forums to easily see photos others have shared!

Thank you so much for playing the game, and for reaching out about issues!

notes.title: Shutter Stroll is coming to the Next Fest! 📸🏝
notes.content:
It's finally time! You'll be able to play the Shutter Stroll Demo this Next Fest! 📸

The demo build will let you visit three islands, generated [i]specifically [/i]for you! Plus, come back [b]each day [/b]to find another new island ready to be photographed, and grab some snaps before it disappears into the aether forever. 🌙

[h3]When?[/h3]
The demo launches [b]June 14th[/b]! I know some of you can't wait for it, so it'll unlock a few days ahead of Next Fest!

[h3]Where?[/h3]
You can play the demo right here on Steam, and share your photos in the Steam Community — or on our [url=https://discord.link/ShutterStroll]Discord[/url]! I'm looking forward to seeing your snapshots!

[h3]What comes after?[/h3]
Make sure to wishlist the game for when it comes out on Steam later this year, with all new features such as:
[list]
[*] A vastly expanded island generator.
[*] Even more camera options, to make each shot your own.
[*] Upgraded visuals.
[*] And as always, a near infinite amount of islands to discover and explore.
[/list]

Want to see more? Here are some photos our Discord beta testers have taken:
